name: Signature Holo

components.pose: She stands with the staff raised in one hand and her other palm open to the light, rays pouring from behind her like a halo, chin lifted, a serene, radiant gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.expression: a serene, warm smile, eyes soft with compassion.
components.effects: A great sunburst of {{MAGIC}} light blazes behind her, beams fall through the stained-glass windows, golden motes and drifting feathers of light fill the air and the marble floor glows beneath her feet.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Lumira, filling the high windows behind her with its head lowered toward her, radiant rose-gold and radiant-gold scales, wreathed in soft solar glow, wings like panes of stained light edged in polished white gold

notes: HOLO edition 'Radiant Saint': the Signature scene re-authored with an ascended pose, upgraded signature weapon, crown, mantle, grander magic and a closer dragon. Holo shader/foil is applied in the client, not baked in.
